goal: Contain and locate the Forseti desktop freeze without interacting with the desktop app.
prohibited_actions: open or drive the desktop UI
acceptance: Identify the concrete source path that can produce event amplification, synchronous UI blocking, or hover-triggered recomputation; do not infer a root cause from process liveness.
Patch only an evidenced cause and add an offline regression test or static contract test.
Run the targeted test and git diff --check without launching the desktop app.
Write a Delivery Receipt containing changed files, test output, remaining unknowns, and why no live UI claim is made.
done_definition: SUBMITTED only; an independent verifier must pass the acceptance criteria before VERIFIED_COMPLETE.
on_stall: Persist the exact command, observed evidence, blocker, and next action. Do not broaden into continuity, controller, or product UI work.
